entry.title: Graduate Educator Advancement and Teaching Fellowship

link.title: Graduate Educator Advancement and Teaching Fellowship

entry.content:
I will be a graduate student fellow for the Graduate Educator Advancement and Teaching (GREAT) Office, working on a series of events to promote more active conversations about disabilities among graduate students. The series will be called Graduate Resources for Accommodations and Supportive Practices (GRASP).

Here are some details for the upcoming events:

  • Disability Awareness Lunch and Learn
  • Workshop: Requesting Accommodations as Graduate Students
  • Panel: Creating a Culture of Care
